I went to school long enough to read the numbers on the fertilizer bag, but I still trust what I see in my own field more than what any officer tells me. Last season I put one bag of DAP at planting and one bag of urea when the maize was knee-high on this plot, and I got enough extra grain to pay for the inputs and still feed my family through August. I will spread cow manure from my three cattle before the rains come because this land is mine and I want to keep it soft, and my sons will do most of the hoe work though I will pay for about twenty days of hired labor when the weeds are thick and the beans on the other plots also need attention.
